title: Heart Failure Medicines
subtitle: Uses, mechanisms, benefits, side effects, interactions, monitoring, and safety related to heart failure medicines.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from large randomized controlled trials and guideline recommendations supports the use of key heart failure medications including ACE inhibitors, beta blockers, aldosterone antagonists, and ARNIs. Emerging therapies like SGLT2 inhibitors have growing evidence. Safety data and monitoring guidelines are well defined.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
